mapper.select: select d.dataset_id, d.title, d.description, d.provider, d.source_type, d.spatial_type, d.file_format, d.original_srid, d.storage_srid, d.analysis_srid, d.is_spatial, d.is_public, d.status, c.category_name_ko, d.created_at, d.updated_at from sd_gis_dataset d inner join sd_data_category c on d.category_id = c.category_id where d.dataset_id = #{datasetId} and d.deleted_at is null
select u.organization from sd_gis_dataset d inner join sd_user u on d.created_by = u.user_id where d.dataset_id = #{datasetId}
mapper.sql: with point_features as ( select f.feature_id, f.feature_name, f.geom_4326 from sd_gis_feature f where f.dataset_id = #{datasetId} and f.geom_4326 is not null and upper(coalesce(f.spatial_type, '')) like '%POINT%' ), neighbor_counts as ( select base.feature_id, base.feature_name, base.geom_4326, greatest(count(target.feature_id) - 1, 0)::int as nearby_count from point_features base join point_features target on ST_DWithin(base.geom_4326::geography, target.geom_4326::geography, #{radius}) group by base.feature_id, base.feature_name, base.geom_4326 ), ranked as ( select row_number() over (order by nearby_count desc, feature_id asc)::int as rank, feature_id, feature_name, geom_4326, nearby_count from neighbor_counts )
mapper.select: select #{datasetId} as dataset_id, d.title as dataset_title, #{radius} as radius, count(r.feature_id)::int as total_point_count, count(case when r.nearby_count > 0 then 1 end)::int as hotspot_count, coalesce(round(avg(r.nearby_count)::numeric, 2), 0)::double precision as average_nearby_count, coalesce(max(r.nearby_count), 0)::int as max_nearby_count from ranked r cross join sd_gis_dataset d where d.dataset_id = #{datasetId} group by d.title

select r.rank, r.feature_id, coalesce(r.feature_name, concat('Feature ', r.feature_id)) as feature_name, r.nearby_count, round(ST_Y(r.geom_4326)::numeric, 6)::double precision as latitude, round(ST_X(r.geom_4326)::numeric, 6)::double precision as longitude from ranked r order by r.rank limit #{limit}
